column2: (ED:PC) Show Global Rules for Claim Purchases
Shows the current rules associated with purchasing claims via the §M(ED:PC)§! mod.\nIf you are §Ythe Administrator§!, you can also use this menu to change these rules.

ED: Purchase Claims - Global Rules

This mod supports two global rules: Costs & Cooldowns.
Costs are calculated as follows:
- The "Base" cost is a multiple of yearly income.
- The "Min"/"Max" cost is a fixed floor/ceiling on this "Base" cost.
- Prestige cost is equal to the "Min" gold cost.
- Cost display format (below): Base/Min/Max.
Cooldowns between claim purchases:
- Barony ("B") claim purchases NEVER have a cooldown
- County ("C") & Duchy ("D") claim cooldowns aree separated.
You ARE the Administrator: Click to change a rule.
